data.gender_notes: Seraj is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Persian word 'seraj', meaning 'radiant, shining torch'. In Hinduism, it is believed to symbolize calmness, tranquility, and peace. It is often given to babies born during peaceful times. The name Seraj carries the meaning “Calm, radiant, serene” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Seraj usually hope their child will grow to embody calm, radiant, serene and live with faith, good character and purpose.
